_note: UI string table. Keys are dotted identifiers (area.thing). English is the ground-truth fallback: every key used anywhere must exist here. Other languages may omit keys; missing ones fall back to this file via I18n's L() wrapper. Avoid General-Punctuation glyphs (em dash, ellipsis, arrows) - the shared ImGui atlas only covers U+0020-U+00FF, so use ASCII '...', ' - ', '>'. Accented Latin letters are fine. Keep %s/%d placeholders intact and in order.

opt.mm.icon_explainer:
emot3 picks the first icon it finds, in this order:

  1. Bundled icon assigned via Library...
  2. icons/<id>.png in your addons/emot3/icons folder (subfolders welcome).
  3. Bundled AI fallback (only when enabled in General > Icons). Matches /me-motes whose Id matches a bundled stem (lfg, brb, idea, clap, ...).
  4. Letter fallback.

PNG and JPEG are both supported. Each row shows which step its icon came from.

opt.unl.explain_body:
A sync reads which emotes your account has unlocked and marks the matches in your catalog.
Matching is best-effort: it works for built-in emotes and for custom emotes when the command matches.
The API only covers part of the emote list, so a sync only ever adds unlocks - it never removes anything. Core emotes are always unlocked.

Your full emote catalog - what emot3 shows in the Library and Quickbar.
Add, edit, or remove any entry; hover a row's controls for what they do.
opt.em.icon_header: Where each emote's icon comes from
opt.em.icon_explainer:
emot3 picks the first icon it finds, in this order:

  1. Bundled icon assigned via Library...
  2. icons/<id>.png in your addons/emot3/icons folder (subfolders welcome).
  3. Bundled ArenaNet official art. Matches emotes whose Id matches a bundled stem (wave, dance, sit, ...) - built-in emotes always do; a custom emote can opt in by reusing the matching Id.
  4. Bundled AI fallback (only when enabled in General > Icons). Same Id-match rule as step 3, against the bundled AI set.
  5. Letter fallback.

PNG and JPEG are both supported. Each row shows which step its icon came from.
opt.em.bundled_explainer: Adds back any built-in emotes missing from your catalog. Built-in emotes have a fixed id, so Restore only adds what you don't have - your edits are never overwritten.
opt.em.secondary_language_tooltip: Adds a second language's commands as search aliases and helps the API unlock sync recognize emotes. Never changes a name or the command sent.
opt.em.emote_language_tooltip: Language used for built-in emotes you add below.
opt.em.switch_language_note: Applies only to emotes you add from here on. To switch the whole catalog, clear it and Restore in the new language.
opt.em.restore_bundled_tooltip: Adds the built-in emotes missing from your catalog.
opt.em.clear_catalog_tooltip: Deletes every emote in your catalog and empties all favorites categories and unlock marks. Returns the window to its empty first-run state. Cannot be undone.
opt.em.clear_modal_body: This permanently removes all %d emotes, empties every favorites category, and clears all unlock marks.
opt.em.cmd_min: Command must contain at least one character after the slash.
opt.em.id_exists: An emote with Id "%s" already exists.
opt.em.id_tooltip: Stable key for favorites and unlock marks. Read-only - delete and re-add to change.
opt.em.cmd_field_tooltip: The slash command sent to chat when you click this emote. Edit to any valid variant - emotes have several and they all work.
opt.em.shared_command_tooltip: Another emote sends the same command. Harmless, just redundant - both open chat with this text.
opt.em.name_dup: Name "%s" is already used by another emote.
opt.em.targetable_tooltip: Lets you suffix this emote with " @" to target it on a creature.
opt.em.core.on: emote is always unlocked (ships with the game).
opt.em.core.off: unlock state is manual - right-click in the Library to toggle.
opt.em.mad_king_tooltip: Part of the "Your Mad King Says..." Halloween event emote set. Drives the optional Mad King category in the Quickbar.
opt.em.keybind.on: registers a Nexus keybind for this emote (a RadialMenus wheel can use it too). Assign a non-printable key like an F-key - a letter or number won't fire reliably, even combined with Ctrl/Alt/Shift. emot3 Plus removes this restriction.
opt.em.aliases_tooltip: Alternate slash commands for search and unlock sync. Not sent - the Command above always fires.
opt.em.clear_icon_tooltip: Clear custom path. Status drops back to the next available source (folder override, bundle, fallback).
shortcut.update_copy_tooltip: Copies the download link to your clipboard.
shortcut.settings_tooltip: Open Nexus > Addons > emot3 for the full Options panel.
